title.narrative: Promoting Creativity in Education through the Use of Digital Technologies

description.narrative: The Project aims to contribute to the transformation of education enabled by digital innovations and to enhancing the quality of education, in alignment with the objectives of the 2030 Education Agenda, through promoting creative thinking in educational settings. A series of thematic events including annual Creativity in Education Summit with the relevant events and International Creative Thinking in Schools Week will be held to foster creativity, innovation and interdisciplinary learning through international collaboration among education institutions and the use of the potential of digital technologies. Expert review of GIoCT’s Poki C App and recommendations on its improvement will be provided within the implementation of the Project. The App aims to achieve critical features: a) become the platform and community for educators at all levels to communicate; b) have the most extensive collection of case studies on creativity in education from around the world; c) a ‘pocket tool’ for educators to devise teaching plans involving creative thinking in minutes.
